title: The Last Patient Escape Room
victim: Denis Arefyev, owner of the escape room
teaser: A group of friends came to a horror escape room to celebrate a birthday. Forty minutes in, the masked maniac stopped jumping out of the dark, and he was found dead in the "operating theatre", locked from the inside. Under the mask was the owner himself, Arefyev, though the rota said an actor was playing that night. The timer on the wall is still counting down to the end of the game, and the exit has never opened.
professions: Car mechanic, the birthday girl's friend
Actor from the escape room next door
Taxi driver who brought the group
Hookah man from the bar upstairs

habits.label: Party hat
clues: The elastic from a paper party hat lies under the trolley in the operating theatre. Hats like that were handed out to the guests at the start of the party. The culprit is wearing a party hat.
On the morgue camera footage, the sharp cone of a party hat sticks up over the edge of the frame. The culprit is wearing a party hat.

habits.label: Fake blood
clues: The operating theatre door handle has a smeared print of fake blood, and the real blood on the floor is a completely different colour. The culprit has fake blood on their hands.
A towel in the actors' changing room is streaked with the sticky red paint the escape room uses by the bucket. The culprit has fake blood on their hands.

habits.label: Phone torch
clues: At 20:41 a sensor in the operating theatre caught a flash of cold white light, like a phone torch. The culprit shines their phone torch.
On the monitor the operator saw a patch of white light moving through the morgue at chest height. The culprit shines their phone torch.

habits.label: Shrieks with fright
clues: At 20:43 the microphone in the barred ward picked up a short shriek, though the actor had already left. The culprit shrieks at every rustle.
The guard in the corridor heard a piercing shriek from the prop store, followed by laughter. The culprit shrieks at every rustle.

habits.label: Confetti in the hair
clues: There are three circles of gold confetti on the tiled floor of the operating theatre, though the party poppers only went off in the waiting area. The culprit has confetti in their hair.
Gold confetti glitters in a body drawer in the morgue. The culprit has confetti in their hair.

habits.label: Latex gloves
habits.habit: Never takes off their latex gloves
clues: Arefyev's mask doesn't have a single fingerprint on it, only matt smudges, as if from latex. The culprit wears latex gloves.
A finger torn off a blue latex glove lies in the toolbox in the prop store. The culprit wears latex gloves.

habits.label: Helium balloon
habits.habit: Drags a helium balloon around on a ribbon
clues: A gold number balloon is stuck to the operating theatre ceiling, its ribbon snapped. The culprit drags a helium balloon around.
The corridor camera caught a shiny balloon floating over the partition by the operator's console. The culprit drags a helium balloon around.

habits.label: Cake cream
habits.habit: A sleeve smeared with cake cream
clues: The handle of the prop scalpel in the operating theatre has sweet white cream on it, the same as on the cake. The culprit has cake cream on their sleeve.
The door of the barred ward has a creamy sleeve mark exactly at elbow height. The culprit has cake cream on their sleeve.

habits.label: High heels
clues: The linoleum by the operating theatre has deep round dents from a thin heel. The culprit wears high heels.
A heel tip broken off a stiletto lies on the morgue tiles. The culprit wears high heels.

habits.label: Arm in plaster
habits.habit: Left arm in a plaster cast
clues: There are white plaster crumbs on the operating theatre wall at shoulder height, as if an arm in a cast had brushed it. The culprit has an arm in plaster.
A wide print of a plaster cast is left on the dusty table in the prop store. The culprit has an arm in plaster.

habits.label: Smells of hookah
clues: Through the smell of paint in the operating theatre comes sweet hookah smoke. The culprit smells of hookah.
One of the jackets on the rack in the actors' changing room smells of cherry hookah. The culprit smells of hookah.

habits.label: Jangling bracelets
habits.habit: Metal bracelets jangle on their wrist
clues: Before the operating theatre went dark, the microphone picked up the thin jangle of bracelets. The culprit wears jangling bracelets.
A thin metal bracelet with a broken clasp lies on the floor of the barred ward. The culprit wears jangling bracelets.

habits.label: Inhaler
habits.habit: Carries an asthma inhaler in their pocket
clues: In his headphones the operator heard a short double puff from the operating theatre, like an inhaler. The culprit carries an inhaler.
An inhaler cap lies under the sofa in the waiting area. The culprit carries an inhaler.

habits.label: Lip ring
habits.habit: A ring in their lower lip
clues: The inside of Arefyev's mask has a small scratch, like from a metal lip ring. The culprit has a lip ring.
The back of a lip piercing glints on the floor of the prop store. The culprit has a lip ring.

habits.label: Braces
clues: A plastic clip from a pair of braces hangs on a cabinet handle in the operating theatre. The culprit wears braces.
In the morgue footage, the torchlight shows a back with crossed brace straps. The culprit wears braces.

habits.label: Shoe covers
habits.habit: Still wearing the blue shoe covers from reception
clues: Soft prints with no tread run from the actors' changing room to the operating theatre, like from shoe covers. The culprit is wearing shoe covers.
A blue shoe cover, torn at the heel, lies in a body drawer in the morgue. The culprit is wearing shoe covers.

tech: The operating theatre's electronic lock jammed from the inside: an extra jumper had been put into its board. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The operating theatre camera footage was replaced with a replay of the neighbouring ten minutes, and the join can't be seen. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
sched: By the script, the maniac comes into the operating theatre at minute forty, and that's exactly when someone was waiting for him there. The culprit knows the schedule.
Every half hour the operator goes out for a five-minute smoke, and that's exactly when the lights went out. The culprit knows the schedule.
quiet: The morgue floor is deliberately covered in fine gravel so players hear the maniac coming, but this time nobody heard a thing. The culprit moves silently.
There's a bell on the door of the barred ward, but it never rang once. The culprit moves silently.
passages: A hidden door behind a cupboard leads from the actors' changing room into the operating theatre. Only staff know about it, and the cupboard has been moved. The culprit knows the service passages.
Under the trolley in the morgue there's a hatch into the ventilation duct that actors crawl through to the operator's console, and its grille has been removed. The culprit knows the service passages.
cash: The day's takings are gone from the reception till, and the payment log is marked "refunded after complaint". The culprit had access to money.
The deposit for tonight went to Arefyev's personal card, and an hour later someone transferred it back. The culprit had access to money.
keys: The staff door from the waiting area was opened with a key, and there are only three such keys. The culprit had keys.
Arefyev's locker in the actors' changing room was opened with a key, and his phone and passport were taken. The phone later turned up on the body. The culprit had keys.
medic: Arefyev was injected in the neck with a sedative from a prop syringe, the dose matched to his weight. The culprit knows about poisons.
A tasteless sedative was slipped into the bottle of water the maniac gets before going on. The culprit knows about poisons.
tools: The ventilation grille in the morgue was taken off and put back, all four screws tightened all the way. The culprit is handy with tools.
The operating theatre door was taken off its hinges with a screwdriver, and the fake rust on the screws was touched up afterwards. The culprit is handy with tools.
driver: Arefyev's car left the underground car park at 20:50 and came back fifteen minutes later, with the seat pushed back for a tall person. The culprit can drive.
There's a delivery scooter with a warm engine at the shopping centre entrance, though the courier was in the waiting area the whole time. The culprit can drive.
french: "Pas de sortie", French for "No way out", is written in blood on the operating theatre mirror. That isn't in the script. The culprit knows French.
Someone has added "Il a menti", French for "He lied", under the patient riddle in the prop store. The culprit knows French.
safe: The safe at the operator's console, where the keys to all the rooms are kept, was opened with the code, and the operating theatre key is gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The combination lock on the cash locker in the prop store was opened on the first try, and it's empty inside. The culprit knows the safe combination.
strong: The trolley with Arefyev's body was shoved behind a screen, though it has a broken wheel and barely moves. The culprit is physically strong.
The cupboard hiding the secret door in the actors' changing room was moved by one person, and it holds cast-iron prop weights. The culprit is physically strong.
